remarks: Welcome home! This beautifully renovated New Canaan estate blends today's modern luxuries with the timeless charm and architecture of its era. From the moment you arrive, the grounds make a lasting impression-professionally landscaped with stonework, graceful iron fencing, and lush greenery that feels like your own private retreat.  Designed for both relaxation and entertaining, the outdoor spaces shine with a custom heated pool, built-in kitchen, bluestone terrace, and two inviting porches-one covered and one screened-perfect for summer dinners, morning coffee, or cozy evenings with friends.  Inside, the warm and welcoming foyer sets the tone. Elegant details and thoughtful design flow throughout, with over 4,100 square feet of living space. The primary suite is a true sanctuary with vaulted ceilings, sun-filled windows, floor-to-ceiling paneling, a large sitting room, and a marble spa bath. Upstairs, four additional bedrooms and a charming reading nook make space for everyone.  The finished lower level adds even more room for entertaining, play, or a home gym. Every inch of this home has been carefully curated so you can move right in and start enjoying the lifestyle New Canaan is known for. A rare opportunity to own a one-of-a-kind estate where every day feels special. Homes like this don't come along often-schedule your private showing
